text: Combining blocks: a second launch, an atomic, or one more trick Three ways to turn one partial per block into one number: (1) a second, small launch that reduces the partials (rungs R1 to R6 above); (2) every block does an atomic add of its partial into one output (A1: one launch, 1.05 ms); (3) the last block to finish, detected with an atomic counter, reduces all partials; (4) a cooperative launch, where grid.sync() makes every block wait for all the others (blocks must all be resident at once, which limits the grid size).
